title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, the exact empirical C2--C7 camera geometry including the C4/C6 antipodal channels, the sharp critical cutoff-tail expansion with explicit remainder, the collective raw-energy expansion, and the exact logarithmic first/second cutoff jets generated by M^(-s-1).
